name: account-bars
description: Right-side sidebar with session and weekly limit bars for each of your Claude accounts; suggests the next same-org account at the session limit.

order.title: Account order
order.description: Profile labels (folder names under ~/.claude-accounts), comma-separated, first in line first. Unlisted accounts follow alphabetically.

claudePath.title: claude executable
claudePath.description: Full path to the claude executable when it is not at ~/.local/bin/claude (claude.exe on Windows). It is never looked up by name.
